Update for Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### Which file?

Pick the jar that ends in your Minecraft version:

- `belis-skylyrics-0.7.0+1.21.11.jar` for **1.21.11**.
- `belis-skylyrics-0.7.0+26.1.jar` for **26.1**, **26.1.1** and **26.1.2**.
- `belis-skylyrics-0.7.0+26.2.jar` for **26.2**.
- `belis-skylyrics-0.7.0+26.3.jar` for **26.3**.

Fabric API is still needed, in the version that matches your Minecraft.

### New

- **Minecraft 26.1 and 26.3.** SkyLyrics now comes for four Minecraft versions, all built from the same code, so every new feature reaches all of them at once.
- **Death animation.** In the World layout, the floating words drop out of the sky when you die, spinning as they fade, and start fresh once you respawn. It's on by default; switch it off under **Position → Death animation**.
- **Lilac theme.** The line is written out word by word across the night sky in soft lilac with a pink glow. Pick it under **Look → Themes**.
- **Top hat.** A new hat: tall and black with a band that glows in your lyrics colour. Pick it under **Look → Hat** and look in third person (F5).
- **Glow colour.** The glow can now have its own colour instead of the words' colour, say pink around lilac words. Set it under **Look → Style → Glow colour** once the glow is on.

### Better

- **Flowing line reads like a sentence.** With **Flowing line** on, words sit closer together with normal word spaces, small words line up with the big ones beside them, and the line turns as one, gently rising or falling with its words tilted to match. Each new word glides into place as it fades up, its glow following just behind. With **Keep the whole line** on too, the full line now stays up until the next one starts, however many words it has.
- **Sharper floating words.** World layout words are drawn from finer letter images, so big words close to you stay crisp on high-resolution screens.
- **Floating words do a little less work each frame.**

### Fixed

- **Hats on 26.3** darken at night and underground like on the other versions, instead of glowing at full brightness.
- **Song library:** a playlist with one song says "1 song", not "1 songs".
- **Lyrics that wouldn't show.** A song whose lyrics file had a stray or broken timing tag used to show no lyrics at all. It now shows them.
